# Sarah-cat

## Overview

- **Age:** eight years old  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P59](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0059)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P58](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0058)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Sarah-cat is a large, sleek cat with gray-and-white fur. She carries herself with an enormous sense of dignity.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P58](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0058)_

## Personality

Sarah-cat is an eight-year-old animal renowned as a remarkable mouser who never engages in fights. She is a purring, companionable presence that brings comfort during the night.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P59](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0059), [v3 ch.Anne-girl P25](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0025)_

## Goals

## History

The Sarah-cat was originally given to [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) by her washerwoman. She moved into Patty's Place alongside [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) and another cat named [Joseph](../character/joseph.md). Upon arrival, the Sarah-cat quickly established her dominance over [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), a stray cat that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) had adopted.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P2](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0002), [v3 ch.Relationships P44](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0044), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 ch.Relationships P58](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0058), [v3 ch.Relationships P62](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0062), +1 more_
